notice: Candidate need/function catalogue, not a finding of actual local shortage, assignment of personal religious obligation, or spiritual ranking. Project data are organiser claims, not independent verification.
classification_basis: Provisional juristic research; consult sources and scholars

needs.title: Religious teaching and scholarly succession
needs.purpose: Provide reliable basic religious instruction and sustain qualified future teachers and jurists.
tests: Access to reliable instruction
Competence and supervision of teachers
Advanced training and scholarly succession

needs.title: Curricula for contemporary intellectual discourse
needs.purpose: Develop the intellectual competence needed to understand and respond responsibly to contemporary scientific, philosophical and technical debates.
tests: Specify missing learner competencies
Assess existing teaching and curricula
Evaluate actual learning and teacher formation

needs.title: Necessary medical care
needs.purpose: Ensure clinically significant medical needs can be addressed through competent, accessible treatment.
tests: Relevant clinical needs and waiting periods
Qualified treatment capacity and access
Quality and continuity of care

needs.title: Safe water, sanitation and infrastructure
needs.purpose: Sustain indispensable water, waste handling, roads and civil infrastructure where reliable provision is required.
tests: Service safety and reliability
Waste collection and pollution indicators
Maintenance capacity and interruption risk
sources: Classical discussions of necessary crafts and utilities

needs.title: Secure food access
needs.purpose: Ensure reliable, affordable access to essential food without presuming that local production is always necessary where trade suffices.
tests: Household food security and affordability
Stability of supply and alternatives
Access under disruption

needs.title: Safety and accountable governance of advanced AI
needs.purpose: Investigate credible grave harms from advanced AI to life, justice, institutions and human moral agency, and identify effective safeguards.
tests: A specified risk mechanism and its evidence
Independent evaluation of proposed safeguards
Existing institutional response and remaining gaps
sources: General duties to prevent grave harms

needs.title: Care for dependent and vulnerable people
needs.purpose: Prevent neglect and grave harm to vulnerable dependants through family, community and appropriate institutional arrangements.
tests: Existing personal obligations identified
Care needs and safety
Access to respite and adequate support
sources: Classical treatment of family and communal duties

needs.title: Funeral rites and burial provision
needs.purpose: Ensure competent and accessible performance of obligatory funeral rites and burial arrangements.
tests: Qualified practitioners and access
Appropriate facilities and coordination

needs.title: Adequate provision for vulnerable households
needs.purpose: Investigate whether households can access necessary material, educational, health and social provisions, including properly administered assistance where warranted.
tests: Define household costs and access locally
Distinguish zakat eligibility thresholds from collective legal duties
Assess continuity, dignity, accessibility and longer-term support
sources: Abdul Muzil Abd Rahim, UKM (2025), ḥadd al-kifāyah

needs.title: Vocational capability and pathways into livelihood
needs.status: Potential means; not automatically a separate farḍ kifāya
needs.purpose: Prepare people for competent, lawful and sustainable livelihood when training and access to work are genuinely necessary to remedy dependence or exclusion.
tests: Identify viable work and market demand
Evaluate training quality and earnings after completion
Check household needs, safety and alternatives
sources: Malaysian research on social entrepreneurship and human capital

needs.title: Sustainable community and mosque institutions
needs.purpose: Examine the spaces, governance, qualified personnel, finances and services needed for community learning, care, worship and social cooperation.
tests: Separate building, maintenance and service functions
Analyse real usage and accessible alternatives
Evaluate governance, financial sustainability and benefit
sources: Abd Wakil et al., Journal of Fatwa Management and Research (2024)

needs.title: Accessible mental-health and psychosocial care
needs.status: Potentially necessary clinical provision; status context-dependent
needs.purpose: Provide safe, competent care and professional formation where serious mental-health needs lack effective support, while distinguishing clinical needs from general wellness activities.
tests: Document access to qualified clinicians and appropriate care
Assess service quality, supervision and safety
Study actual unmet need rather than promotional demand
sources: Classical duty to prevent serious harm (requires contemporary legal derivation)

needs.title: Emergency relief and displacement support
needs.status: Contextual responsibilities to avert grave harm
needs.purpose: Secure food, safe water, health and other essential support during acute displacement or disaster, including coordination and continuity of supply.
tests: Verify the acute humanitarian situation independently
Map relief provision, gaps and competing authorities
Examine logistics, safety, local participation and sustainability
sources: Juristic duties concerning rescue and prevention of grave harm (further verification)
Organiser reports and independent humanitarian data needed

needs.title: Safe temporary shelter and stabilisation
needs.purpose: Investigate provision of safe shelter, protection and basic services for displaced persons, with attention to lawful responsibility and the conditions for lasting stabilisation.
tests: Document the affected population and emergency housing supply
Assess safety, family integrity, health and access
Verify agencies' responsibilities and alternatives
sources: General duties concerning protection and grave harm (juristic assessment required)
Independent displacement and housing data required

evidence_policy: A research example may document an outcome, a provider activity or a source-defined capacity gap. None automatically certifies complete sufficiency, a legal obligation or individual duty.
